title: Multiscale ATE Estimation with Unknown Propensity Vanishing Linearly at the Boundary
banked_reason: D-0.5 v3: publishability_tier=letter, below field floor; N-no-stat-frontier-advance: lone upper bound without matched converse or strict common-class comparison.
gap_reasons: tier=letter below novelty_target=field: this is a lone upper bound for a self-defined estimator on a self-defined class, with neither a matched converse, a strict rate/constant comparison on a common published class, nor an externally established first-result frontier.

The purported total estimator is not fully defined: the clipped within-cell control ratio, the boundary arm means, and the exact summation defining theta-hat are prose placeholders rather than measurable formulas, so the theorem's risk and interval claims have no uniquely specified procedure.
They characterize Zeng et al. as fixed-positivity only, but v3 explicitly says its rate statements remain meaningful when the positivity constant epsilon=epsilon_n shrinks.
proof_attempt_summary: The presolve's raw histogram upper bound failed on aligned asymmetric quarter-Hölder tents; the revised angle replaced it with a centered factorial estimator certificate. Review then found the certificate incompletely specified, the Zeng comparison inaccurate, and the surviving claim limited to an upper bound below the field floor. The exact matched minimax risk and honest interval length remain open; a future run needs a same-class converse or a proved strict improvement over published work.
tldr: The sole headline contribution is an explicit five-fold centered multiscale estimator for the full-population ATE on the fixed quarter-Hölder class with \(e(x)\asymp x\). Dyadic shells use a coarse response center, an independently estimated centered treated-success moment, and a derived geometric polynomial for \(1/e\) implemented by centered factorial statistics; cell projection and an independent stability gate make the construction total. A deterministic finite-sample certificate evaluates to root risk \(O\{(\log^2(en)/n)^{5/22}\}\) and yields a data-only uniformly honest connected interval. No lower frontier, known-propensity benchmark, exact-rate claim, or matched-order claim is part of this proposal.
gap: Existing discrete polynomial estimators and asymptotic weak-overlap inference do not give a finite-sample observable reciprocal construction with continuous Hölder cell bias, unknown propensity, and uniform full-population coverage on this class.
fill: The construction fixes every fold, shell, cell width, polynomial degree, coefficient, factorial statistic, projection, gate, and radius, and evaluates the resulting deterministic certificate at a named conservative rate.
